verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents pay-as-you-go Spot Node Pools and On-Demand GPU capacity with no long-term commitments. It also offers billing insights that break down usage by resource type. Together these loosely imply usage-based billing, but no evidence states the billing granularity or that charges stop when nodes are not running. Missing for 10: documented per-second or per-minute billing granularity, explicit confirmation that billing applies only while instances run, independent or hands-on corroboration.
